content.short: Licensed payment platform for pay-ins, payouts and FX across stablecoins, fiat and 80+ currencies.
content.description: Orbital lets businesses receive, exchange and settle major stablecoins, standard currencies and more than 80 exotic currencies through one platform, available on the web, by API or through an OTC desk. It offers named virtual IBANs and stablecoin wallets, operates under licences in the UK, Gibraltar, Estonia and Switzerland, and processes about $12 billion a year.
content.meta: Collect, convert and pay out in stablecoins, fiat and 80+ exotic currencies with Orbital, licensed in 4 jurisdictions.
